add_preset.description:
The values start at what the light is showing now (total power {power} %). {headroom}

Tip: for a live power reading, set the light up with the sliders on the device page while watching the Power sensor, then come back here. Leave Fan empty if the preset shouldn't change the fan.

remove_preset.description: Schedule steps that use a removed preset are skipped (with a warning in the log).

add_schedule.title: Add or update a schedule step

data_description.fade: On: how long the sunrise takes from the step's time. Off: how long before the step's time the sunset starts. 0 = switch instantly.
data_description.curve: Only used when the step fades.
data_description.smoothness: Only used when the step fades.

display.title: Slider or number input
display.description: How the 1. R – 5. Fan controls appear on the device page.

fade.title: Fade smoothness and curve
fade.description: Smoothness sets how often the light gets a new level during a fade: Fine sends a command for every level step (smoothest, most commands); Medium (the default) and coarser settings send fewer, slightly bigger steps. The Natural curve makes sunrises and sunsets look even to the eye.

power.title: Power limit
power.description:
The app never lets the light's total power go above 100 % (R counts 39 %, G 41 %, B 53 %, UV 11 % at full). With all channels at 100 % the light would draw 144 %, which can overheat the LEDs and power supply. With the limit on, anything above 100 % is scaled down proportionally (same colors, a bit dimmer), and single channel sliders refuse changes that would exceed it, like the app.

Only turn this off if you know your light can handle it.

data.power_limit: Keep total power at or below 100 % (recommended)

edit_preset.title: Edit a preset
edit_preset.description: Choose the preset, and how you'd like to edit it. For a live power reading, load it onto the light, adjust it with the sliders on the device page while watching the Power sensor, then come back and choose Save what the light shows now into it.

edit_preset_values.title: Edit {name}

data_description.apply: Sends the new values to the light when you submit.

acclimation.title: Acclimation

data.shorten: Light period shorter at the start

data_description.shorten: Off steps run this much earlier at the start (0 = keep the normal light period).
data_description.shorten_step: How much longer the light period gets at each step.

power_over.title: Over the power limit
power_over.description:
These values add up to {power} % total power ({asked}), but the light is limited to 100 %.

Scaled down: {scaled} = {scaled_power} %, the same colour slightly dimmer.

menu_options.power_back: Go back and change the values

co2.title: CO₂

data.control: Switch CO₂ with the light schedule
data.on_before: CO₂ on before the first On step
data.off_before: CO₂ off before the last Off step
data.backstop: The plug has its own off schedule or auto-off as a backstop

data_description.lead: How long CO₂ must be on before the light may go to full brightness.
data_description.fallback: Share of the step's brightness while CO₂ isn't ready (0 = keep the light off).
data_description.off_before: Before the time the light is fully off. Plants use little CO₂ while the light fades.

modes.title: Maintenance and photo modes
modes.description: Turning on the Maintenance mode or Photo mode switch shows this preset for this long, skipping schedule steps, then fades back to the schedule by itself.

error.name_builtin: That name is used by one of the app's presets. Choose another.
error.name_exists: You already have a preset with this name. Use Edit a preset to change it.
error.cannot_apply: Couldn't reach the light to show the preset (is the phone app connected?). Untick Show on the light now to just save it.
error.step_zero: With a step of 0 the program would never reach your normal schedule.
error.nothing_to_do: Start brightness is 100 % and the light period isn't shortened, so there's nothing to do.
error.fade_before_midnight: This Off step's fade would have to start before midnight. Use a later time or a shorter fade.
error.co2_entity_missing: Choose the entity that switches your CO₂.
error.co2_not_switchable: CO₂ control needs an entity that can be switched (a switch, light or input boolean), not a sensor.
error.co2_backstop_required: Set up an off schedule or auto-off in the plug itself first, then tick this box.

abort.loaded: {name} is now on the light. Adjust it with the sliders on the device page (the Power sensor shows the total live), then open Configure → Edit a preset → {name} → Save what the light shows now into it.
abort.cannot_apply: Couldn't reach the light (is the phone app connected?). Nothing was changed.
abort.light_off: The light is off, so there's nothing to save. Turn it on or load the preset first.

light_unreachable.title: {name} can't be reached
light_unreachable.description:
Commands to {name} have been failing since {since}. The schedule keeps retrying, but the light may not be following it.

Check that the light has power, that the WEEK AQUA phone app isn't connected (the light accepts one connection), and that the Raspberry Pi's Bluetooth is in range.

Last error: {error}

This notice disappears by itself once a command gets through.
